com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.xni.parser

类 XMLParseException

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Throwable
      • java.lang.Exception
        • java.lang.RuntimeException
          • com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.xni.XNIException
            • com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.xni.parser.XMLParseException
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    Serializable

    public class XMLParseException
extends XNIException
    A parsing exception. This exception is different from the standard XNI exception in that it stores the location in the document (or its entities) where the exception occurred.
    作者:
    Andy Clark, IBM
